notablePrerequisites:
Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.

description:
Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color with which you have devotion.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
